Γραμμικό σύνολο δεδομένων που αφορά στο οδικό δίκτυο του Δήμου Ι.Π. Μεσολογγίου.Πηγή: ΕΛΣΤΑΤ. Coverage: Δήμος Ιεράς Πόλεως Μεσολογγίου. The publisher named on the listing is Δήμος Ιεράς Πόλεως Μεσολογγίου. Its keywords include inspire, messolonghi, gis, γεωχωρικά, features. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, SHAPE-ZIP, CSV, XML. The listing shows 2026-05-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
